title: Figure 16: Bussard Ram Jet Interstellar Spacecraft Illustration
description: Color rendering of a long interstellar spacecraft against a black background with a 500 m scale bar. Labeled components include fusion exhaust, fusion shield assembly, igniters, compression assembly, habitation section, command antenna, power distribution, precompressor, collector head and magnetic torus. Caption: 'Figure 16. Bussard Ram Jet (www.bibsos.com)'.
